claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted contract-workflow action in scope of the Pack is bound to an open matter with a defined scope of authority via the canonical KYE Authority Register.
No AI-generated or AI-redlined artefact is released to a client or counterparty until a qualified supervising lawyer named on the matter has reviewed and signed off.

AI-assisted decisions crossing the matter risk-escalation threshold (uncapped liability, indemnity, off-playbook deviation, governing-law change, value over limit) escalate to a supervising partner before acceptance.
Privileged, confidential, or special-category client material is refused egress outside the matter trust domain, preserving SRA confidentiality and the UK GDPR Article 28 processing boundary.

Each AI-assisted redline emits a signed, replay-derivable negotiation Evidence Pack binding the matter scope, playbook clause, risk classification, lawyer-review state, and Authority Finality outcome.
